## Profile

Frontend developer who has been building and deploying websites, e-shops and PWAs for the web agency IMPnet as a freelancer since 2022 – around 150 projects so far. I develop with AI agents in Claude Code: I write custom skills, build multi-agent workflows and maintain a knowledge base the agents work from. A background in PR and customer support means I am comfortable working with clients in Czech, English and French.

## AI in development

- Claude Code as my main development environment – getting oriented in unfamiliar code, implementing, reviewing the result and recording decisions.
- Custom skills: automated translation of localized content in a TinyMCE CMS (tested with jsdom), restyling a website from a Figma design, scroll-driven animations.
- Multi-agent Figma-to-components pipeline: an orchestrator with subagents, Code Connect as the source of design tokens.
- A knowledge base for agents (Obsidian “LLM wiki”) that agents read and update after every task.
- MCP integrations – Figma, browser, file system.
